name: FX Money Contract, Quote Evidence & Provider Adapter Foundation

files.description: Pure domain contracts for exact money, normalized rates, provider adapter interface, quote evidence, policies, and health
Exact arbitrary-precision decimal arithmetic and rounding engine using Prisma.Decimal; prohibits binary float for money
Provider-neutral rate normalization (direct & inverse pairs, timestamps) and deterministic fake adapter with health tracking
Strict pair-isolated, TTL-aware in-memory cache for FX rates with baseline retention
Pure domain quote service implementing createFxQuote, freshness validation, outlier protection, canonical browse fallback, and quote evidence builder

Focused P5A test suite covering exact money, rounding, 0/2/3 digits, rate normalization, quote evidence reproducibility, cache isolation, provider failures, outlier protection, and financial boundaries
